Model routers often combine request features, estimated capability, response
quality, cost, and uncertainty. The TREC task emphasizes ranking candidates,
so an operational router is related but not identical.

## Why this matters for 2026

It offers vocabulary for reliability signals and learned fusion.

## What this does not prove

Operational routing performance does not transfer automatically to this
candidate-ranking evaluation. Follow citations in the
[`controlling review`](../../../reports/trec_2025_mllm_literature_review.md).
